How a camera network meant for traffic was used to follow people
Cameras installed to catch speeding drivers were searched thousands of times for reasons that had nothing to do with traffic.
By Jo Maddox and Sam Ferris

Exclusive
Nobody was checking the searches. So we did.
Our review of the search logs led to two officials being disciplined, and to new rules on who can see the footage.
By Sam Ferris and Jo Maddox

The camera supplier promises changes after our report
The company says it will add audit logs and limits on searches after our reporting showed how easily the system could be misused.
By Jo Maddox, Sam Ferris and Lee Cho
